items.title: The Jensen Interceptor is back as a 960 bhp track monster
items.summary: The Jensen Interceptor was never a conventional British Grand Tourer. Built between 1966 and 1976, it combined Italian styling, British craftsmanship and big American V8 power, creating one of the most distinctive grand tourers of its era. The original car used Chrysler V8s, with engines growing from 6.3 to 7.2 litres, while the related Jensen FF even brought four-wheel-drive and anti-lock brakes to the luxury GT long before they became commonplace.
